content: Piter cawh thong-ing taitah khuarawha chui pawtah a pia
Ma cai hrawnghrang lehei siangpahrang Herod tah khrisawbu chung taitei zingtu thaikhehpaw sahlo khah hreh rua pawtah a tlesah he.
Ama taco Johan a uteipaw Jeims khah zyzi tah a thawsah he.
Ma taco Juda cawngsaw sahlo khah a lawngsah he tahpaw a hmuh tihtah Piter zong khah a tlesah pai he. Ma heh Thino pahlawh lypaw Very Panaw chung tah a cang.

Aa tle khy taico, thong letah thlahsah he ka, raekeh papali longmang khei phupali tah cong pawtah khei a chia he. Herod taco Khungsai Panawnah khy taitah mehpui hme leco chuakhui tah a biace pá pawtah khei a pachia.
Macawtaco Piter cawh thong letah thlah he ka, canghrasala khrisawbu taco a cawtah Khazing khatah hmuisui teitah thlaw aa chang.
Herod tei a biace pápaw a tah ning hlai zai leco, Piter cawh bahrairui sanghning khei tongchai he ka, raekeh pahning aa kaa lekhei isah he ka, ingkaw cawh raevai pahning takhei aa cong.

Sung sungkheh tah Abuipaw a vaiming cawh a za paly ka, a ungnahpaw chung cawh a khai thlu. Vaiming taco Piter cawh a kang lekhei pheh ka, a pahrah. “Tho pahraw!” tah ka, bahrairui cawh Piter a kihkong kongnah taico a tlahthlah thlu.
Mataico vaiming taco, “Na chaichi khah a tua la, na phepakong khah a pakong,” tatah a tah. Mataico, ma hraco Piter tah a tua. “Na angki a pasuapaw khah a pazai la, pazui,” tatah vaiming taco a tah.
Piter taco thong-ing alailang cawh a zui, canghrasala vaiming tei a tuapaw khah a hmuisuipaw a cang tahpaw hnih be; apalynah ka hmuh rua tatah a rawh.

A pakhehnah le a pahningnah raevaitu khah khungsai he ka, khuapui chunglang seinah thawrui hawkaw aa va phah. Ma ingkaw cawh ama hawng tah ahawng thah ka, ma lang co aa piathlah. Langpui cawh aa va tlung tihtah sung sungkheh tah vaiming taco a seisai.

Mataico Piter cawh a lung ka sing ka, “Atoheh cawh Abuipaw tah a vaiming za thlaw ka, Herod kih chung taitah le Juda cawngsaw sahlo a pachianah pawhe vytei chung taikhei a pa pachah tahpaw heh lung langlo lytah ka hni myca,” tatah a tah.
A cung letei hming ungzia khah a hnipase tihtah Marka tah zong tah aa ypaw Johan a no Mari a ing, cawngsaw hlupui a pahmo he katei, thlaw aa chang leimeinah pawlang khah a vaw.
Piter taco ingkaw cawh khong ka, ingkaw hong ruapaw taco Roda aa tahpaw sae canu khah a va sei.
Piter a cang tahpaw khah a o tah a bi tihtah a thawchah ngetei ka, ingkaw cawh hong lytah sai kaw ka, “Piter ingkaw letah a daw thlang,” tatah a ching he.
“Na lung sing ná maw?” tah he ka, ahmangpaw ka rei, a tah tihtah, “A vaiming a cang a,” tatah aa tah.
Canghrasala Piter taco ingkaw cawh khong vy ka, ingkaw cawh ka hong he ka, aa hmuh tihtah aa ning a ang thlang.

Piter taco de law tákhei, a kiá tah tuapah he ka, Abuipaw tah thong chung taitei a piakhuinah kong khah a ching he. Taico, “Jeims le uny ahringpaw sahlo zong khah ma kong heh thuisah my lo,” tatah tah ka, mataico piathlah ka, ahringpaw hminghmaw lang a sei.
Mongrang taco raekeh hrong chung lekhei, Piter heh zekhatah a tua ka maw a pia zia, tah he ka, aa buaiba ngetei he.

Herod taco huisah caimang tei he ka, aa hmuh ly tih taco, a vaipaw sahlo khah bia hae he ka, aa palei khylynah caw takhei naa thaw he a, a tah he. Herod thihnah Mataico, Herod cawh Judia raang taikhei Sisaria khua lang khah sei ka, ma leco a va ung cong.

Herod cawh Tair le Sidon khua sahlo letei a ungpaw he cawngsaw aa cung lekhei a thing a ae ngetei. Ma khua cawngsaw thaikheh cawh a pahmo he ka, ama a tongpaw takhei a pachia he. Siangpahrang tei a paichai ngeteipaw a sae Blasta khah aa laipasong khy taitah arainah khah aa va hae, zecawtamaw tatah lawh aa hmuh nápaw cawtah khei siangpahrang a raang khah aa tythlangnah cawtah a cang.
A tongnah ning leco Herod cawh a buichaichi khah a tua ka, a buidyching leco a ty ka, zawpui khaco biareinah cawh a hnui.
Zawpui taco, “Ma heh cawngsaw o le rei cang be, khazing o le rei a cang,” tatah aa y.
Herod takhei Khazing khah reithainah a peh lynah cawtah Abuipaw a vaiming takhei sung sungkheh tah tuh ka, salung takhei e ka, a thi.
Canghrasala Khazing bia cawh a kaipaza lo leimei.
Barnaba le Saul cawh aa raihrenah khah aa pachang tihtah Jerusalem khuapui lang khah va kaw kaw he ka, Marka tah zong tah aa ypaw Johan khah a va chui he.
